column3: BSB adds “this stone” and renders “the head of the corner” as “the cornerstone.”
BSB renders “the day of visitation” as “the day He visits us.”
BSB renders “conscience toward God” as “conscious of God.”
BSB follows the critical text with “for you … leaving you” (ἐκλήθητε); the Textus Receptus reads “for us … us.”
BSB puts the verse in quotation marks.
